# Avali
[color=#ffa500]Avali have several significant gameplay differences from baseline humanoids.[/color]
Avali are small bird/raptor-like humanoids adapted to cold environments.
## Racial Features
- Receive [color=#ffa500]40% more heat damage[/color] and [color=#1e90ff]40% less cold damage[/color]. - Can tolerate temperatures down to roughly [color=#1e90ff]-50 C[/color] before beginning to take cold damage. - Deal [color=red]6.25[/color] slashing damage with their claws. - Have increased acceleration while weightless. - Become hungry roughly 1.8 times faster than a normal humanoid. - Fall into critical condition at [color=red]90[/color] damage and die at [color=red]180[/color]. - Speak Tau Ceti Basic and Scratch.
## Sounds
Avali make a variety of bird-like vocalizations, including chirps, squawks, trills, calls, and screes.
They also have their own hiss, purr, and growl sounds.
## Nanite Shell
Avali can encase themselves in a [color=#ffbc48]Nanite Shell[/color], entering stasis while nanites repair their damaged organic tissue.
The shell repairs brute damage more quickly than heat and cold damage and also reduces bleeding.
While inside the shell, the Avali cannot move and most actions are prevented. Incoming damage is reduced while the shell is active.
The nanites can restore up to [color=#7CFC00]50 total damage[/color] before the shell ends. The shell can also break early after taking enough incoming damage.
